decisions.reason: The GA4 plugin builds directly on the firm’s analytics and plugin expertise and targets the current analytics standard, so the firm can absorb feedback and improve it, making withdrawal unlikely.
The retail system interface plugin leverages the firm’s interface development and partner networks, enabling it to interpret implementation feedback and refine the product, so it is likely kept.
As a relaunch SEO support service, it extends existing SEO and project capabilities and has dedicated web presence, reflecting strong absorptive capacity and commitment.
The SEO workshops build on the firm’s established SEO knowledge and allow direct client feedback to improve the format, so the firm can assimilate and apply this service, making withdrawal unlikely.
